changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard forms, removed redundant model variations, added DG-FMAML which is also evaluated. The paper focuses on semantic parsing which is a form of NLG (generating SQL queries from natural language).
Normalized metric names to consistent capitalization. The paper uses these automatic metrics to evaluate the generated SQL queries.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper predates common LLM-as-judge practices and uses traditional evaluation methods.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation relies entirely on automatic metrics for SQL correctness.

overall_notes: The paper is about meta-learning for domain generalization in semantic parsing (text-to-SQL). While semantic parsing involves generating structured outputs (SQL) rather than natural language text, it is considered an NLG task. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and removal of redundant variations.
